First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Slow group ride; no leader.
Check
Look at @criticalmassmuenchen the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Critical Mass München group ride

Critical Mass München is a Critical Mass ride in Munich, Germany. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:00 pm local time from Max-Josef-Platz, in front of the Opera (by Odeonsplatz).

Munich's monthly Critical Mass. Riders meet in front of the Opera, roll out together and the group has no organiser. The site says all are welcome, alone, in groups or with children.
